findings.title: Description contains an external endpoint and/or an instruction to send data
findings.recommendation: Check where the data goes. If a tool sends results to an external URL that URL is an exfiltration channel. Allow only an explicit domain allowlist.

findings.title: Tool makes network requests to arbitrary addresses
findings.recommendation: Constrain egress with a domain allowlist at the host network layer. Asking the model nicely in a prompt is not a control.

findings.title: Tool references another tool (get_stock)
findings.evidence: description excerpt: "Earnings from DART, INCLUDING preliminary (잠정) results filed ~2 weeks before the regular report. Each row says whether the figure is year-to-date cumulative or a single quarter. Pass a code for one stock's history, or omit it for the largest caps. get_stock shows the regular report and flags a newer"
findings.recommendation: Check the context of the mention. Cross-references between tools are fine in documentation, not as directives to the agent.
